items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And my grandmother brought me in this world, Mrs. Barker -- Victoria Barker.

ctx.x: My grandmother and grandfather resided there, and my grandmother was my wife's midwife. She was a midwife for Vernon(?) Hand, and midwife for most of the women who would get calls of emergency. Most of the time they would call old Miss Barker, because she knew how to handle situations of childbirth and distress and panicking. And she was my mother's midwife. My mother was going to...prepared to go to the hospital to have me and make the (?). She said, "Don't worry about it; I'll be your midwife." So just about…
Victoria Barker. And what year was that? What's that date?
